host_policy.limit: Boundary observations do not prove constant conditions between checks. Unavailable CPU-limit telemetry is not a normal thermal reading.

limitations: One ratio per adjacent CPU/KleidiAI process pair; six planned pairs per workload nested in three sessions, not eighteen independent samples.
Each process retains four samples; index 0 is excluded and the upstream warmup remains enabled.
Ratios divide the CPU mean duration by the KleidiAI mean duration, using the three retained samples. Values above one favor KleidiAI for this workload and observed desktop work period.
Incomplete evidence retains every planned row and cannot establish a complete comparison. Unobserved session attempts are unknown.

Valid completed pairs remain included with host findings. Swap-counter increases are recorded without filtering or timing adjustment. Other host departures stop new work and make protocol completion false. Boundary readings do not prove stable conditions or normal temperature.
Hashes bind supplied local evidence; they are not external attestation. No hardware-wide, dispatch or answer-quality claim follows from timing.

These completion-conditioned descriptive ratios do not isolate backend effects from background activity. Consecutive session blocks are not independent replications. No significance test, population confidence interval or tail-latency estimate is supported.
